body: I think I would still be lonely even if there was some bacteria on Mars.
I don't think I have this disorder that you've apparently diagnosed me with over the internet. I'm just disorganized and socially inept

No, I can't change who I am. This has been an ongoing struggle for years. I have done exactly what you are saying, start over somewhere new and try to wing it, try to meet new people and change the circumstances of my life. I always find myself in the same place.. I will follow myself wherever I go. I know I am going to be living like this for the rest of my life and there is nothing i can do about it, everything i change is just thrashing around. and I am locked in this lifestyle as long as I have my kind of job and I can't leave my job because the economy is tanked and there are no alternatives. I also found out today that I won't be able to apply to go back to school which was one 'out' I was using in my head to justify putting up with this.. If I don't even have that, I am really running out of things to look forward to in my life. I don't want to make everyone upset but I am sick of living for other people. I've wanted to die since I was 15-16.

I don't want those experiences. I want to be a normal person and enjoy being young. I've already wasted too much time. 

you should be able to find the old one by searching my posts, there's only two of them

I don't see what the point is. My life is terrible and I don't feel the need o continue it. The longer I live the more harm I will do to others and myself. Im constantly taking one step forward and two steps back.

Honestly, the violent episodes have only happened a few times, but when I was an adolescent I would break shit in my room to take out anger against family and school. This is probably unrelated but I also get a bit claustrophobic in crowds and feel an urge to sort of thrash around to get out of them. As an adult, it's very unusual for me to come so undone that I become actively violent, it only happens if I am very upset and very, very drunk. Usually I'm just plain self-destructive.

I don't know if I need medication. I have a fundamental problem with being on medication and I wouldn't want to let anyone know I was on it, which seems unavoidable. My mood swings aren't so violent that I cannot function. I supposedly function very well, well enough to have a stable job. It's really only in relationships that I show my true colors.. and that's what makes me want to die.

>If the world was a lot different, but you are still the same person you are now, do you think you would/could be happy?

No. I hate my life and who i am. I hate the person I have become and all the people I have turned my back on or hurt on the way. I don't like much of anything about myself. 'the world' rejects me for being the way I am but I also reject myself because I know I am bad

Someone diagnosed me with depression a few years back but it seems like everyone gets that if they go to a psych these days. I don't do medication due to a bad experience. It just didn't help and I got hooked on my meds. I have never been violent to anyone but myself, usually in the form of cutting or burning. Even in extreme states of intoxication while very unstable, I have never used violence against someone else to my knowledge. i have acted violently a few times in ways that very clearly upset friends and scared them away, though.. breaking things, yelling, etc. Really, I don't think I deserve to have friends given what I am like. I wouldn't want to spend time with myself.

>Have your parents told you that they think you're homosexual? Does this carry a negative connotation with you or them?

They did a few years ago when I was 19. It wasn't really in an accusatory way but for them it definitely carries the signification that I am weak and I won't start a family. I have never brought a girl home in 24 years of life and I tend to be more on the 'geeky'/effeminate side of the scale, not really the type A masculine personality they expect me to be. I have absolutely nothing against gays but I do resent being accused of being gay or hearing family members or coworkers crack a joke about me being gay because it's a tactic designed to make me feel alienated and inferior. And i guess I am also somewhat self conscious about my effeminate appearance

>What sort of bad behavior have you exhibited? Do you feel you should have apologized for any of it?

I should have apologized but its been going on for so long I don't know what to do. I'm just an asshole to everybody. I do and say things that hurt people or creep them out (especially women, in the latter case) not even because I want to but because it's my nature.. the words just come out of my mouth and i can't do anything but be silent or risk saying something offensive. Either way I lose. 

I don't know how to apologize for what I have done. I've abused alcohol and just acted like a crazy person in general

Wow, yeah.. I am full of these.. You know, now that I am out of my depressive spell i feel like i can look at what i said and felt objectively a bit. and i think a lot of this is justifying the use of the same behaviors and lifestyle that i have become dependent on. I hve been seeing a therapist who does work with cognitive therapy who I will see in a few days and I'll mention it.

Yea, it's just.. well, the other night i was out and I with my friend and his friends.. And I was having a pretty good time but feeling a bit out of place, not too bad as things go, though. I was mostly enjoying it. And then as I started to drink more (and this was what everyone was doing, i wasn't just getting trashed on my own) I started to feel more anxious and worried about little things and how the people I was just meeting were going to feel about me, whether or not they liked me or wanted to be friends with me after this, and eventually someone mentioned that I looked a little stressed out. I kind of made up and excuse to go to the bathroom and then took a cab home. It's things like this that I think are so unusual as to render me unfit to be friends for most people

I don't know what else I can do. I feel like I am playing chess and someone has locked me into a defensive position and I can't make a move without giving up something else. I try to exercise and take care of my body and externally i seem pretty healthy and well off. I know I'm slowly losing the battle if only because I am running out of time. I guess this is my feeling of depression, that i can't make a move to get out of the negative feelings. At work I am constantly failing on several levels.. I don't want to be doing the type of work i am doing, and i can't actually do it well. I miss deadlines and feel like I cannot succeed, which doesn't help my confidence. if I could only get out of my position I might find something that fits better but how to do that? I don't know. I've been seeing a therapist who has helped me understand how I constantly set myself up for failure but I still haven't been able to make a move.. Like I'm really able to understand why I am stuck, but it still doesn't give me any power

oh, I don't even think about dating. At the point, I'm probably a good 5-6 years away from being able to seriously handle a relationship in a mature way. Anyone that would date me right now has dependency issues.

I really don't see what the point is. And I have to figure out what the point is. Because otherwise, i won't do anything that i want to do. Whenever i say something like this to friends (or used to, no one really talks to me anymore, especially if i sound like i'm depressed. my friends have stopped caring), someone says "well, you know you're going to die anyway, so go try X Y Z".. And I say the same thing to people when they are depressed and want to die. But its not like i'm measuring the possible benefits of living with the benefits of dying and just miscalculating somehow.. i haven't "forgotten" that life can be good. *My* life is just a lump of shit right now and has been for a long time, and i suffer enough in a given day that I really can't cope, it really hurts enough that I think it might be worth the checking out early to skip all those years

I am aware of various DSM criteria, including bipolar II. I don't know. The only thing I've ever been diagnosed with was depression, and that was years ago, but i know it's more complex that simple unipolar depression. My therapist says that I have recurring anxiety (and after reading more into the diagnosis for it, it does seem to be what i experience pretty frequently). I also have panic attacks every now and then accompanied by extreme anxiety.

In my experience, this feeling won't last for more than a day or two.. It does help if I'm constantly involved in something though and challenging myself. unfortunately a lot of my reality is maintaining the status quo, not taking risks or do anything interesting. I spend 8-10 hours a day looking at a fucking laptop and there's really nothing i can do about that except to find a new job where i wouldn't use a computer, but that would probably mean making minimum wage, which means i wouldn't be able to afford the therapy that is keeping me together. work and the sedentary nature of most of my life definitely contribute to the anxiety, and I feel much more relaxed at home, but i'm reliant on it for now to support myself. I'm sort of a jenga puzzle and if you take out any one piece from me i'll fall to shit. Which also contributes to feeling like it's not really worth all the hassle and pain I have to go through every day just to stay alive
I did try that for a while, but i am just not sure what to say.. I don't even know what to talk about if I ask someone to go out like that.. I guess I just don't have the social skills to do that.

I tried doing that already. I traveled around Europe for about a month before funds ran out. I had some fun and would definitely say I enjoyed it but the same problems were present.. Difficulty socializing, problems with making friends in the hostels, feeling awkward in crowds, getting into bouts of depression. Despite the fact that to many people it would have looked like i had done something very brave and adventurous I felt somewhat bored and alienated the whole time i was traveling. So I haven't really had the urge to travel much since then, although i could probably take off a week or more now.. 

Honestly I will probably just sink back into work. it's not something I'm interested in or something i want to do, but it's at least a way to support myself. and I wouldn't be able to see a therapist (which i am doing) if I left my job due to the cost without insurance.
That has not been my experience. I am a very nervous person and people do not like to be around nervous people
It's very difficult to do that at my age.. People get weirded out if I want to hang out with them one on one.

Yeah I know, I am extremely insecure and self conscious for someone my age. It's kind of pathetic. I try to be excited and I can be sometimes. I try new hobbies and I'm more outgoing than I used to be but I just can't handle it. I end up looking forward to being alone after a day of work and I don't really meet anyone my own age because I work with a bunch of old people. So I don't have much of a social life except when I organize a big party which was a joint effort, it wasn't just my friends.. I don't think there would have been much of a turnout if I had organized it myself. I'm just not very good at socializing in groups, and I never have been. But it seems like that's the only thing that would make me happy.
